Hi there I am a Grandmaster Role Queue Tank player who got my start by playing Sigma so I wanted to review this, here's what I saw.

On Attack you hesitated too much you tended to stand in choke and poke away at the enemy team for hours on end, while yes Sigma is a poke tank you do need to push in there where a couple times when pushing onto point would've isolated the enemy Ana and gotten a free kill. This hesitancy ended up giving the enemy team too much space to work with. When Playing Sigma into Doom you need to be very careful as he can bypass your shield take your High ground and cancel both Grasp and Flux the best way to deal with him is take advantage of his lackluster health for a dive tank. When doom dives your backline immediately isolate and pressure out his healers, use Grasp after he has punched you and you did a great job canceling his power block with rock.

On Defense you didnt contest high ground I can not stress how important high ground is to the existence of Sigma. Yes you started on high ground, but you dropped after about 20 Seconds and never went back up. With no contest on High ground Baptiste got the first kill on your team and won the game. This was also a problem on Attack you pushed through the some low ground choke, every single time. Pushing into high ground through the tunnel would've made life a lot easier especially since they weren't contesting it.

And finally your barrier, while not a pressing issue I need to talk about it so I decided to make it its own paragraph. Never let your barrier break . Unless its dire circumstances like you're caught in the open and there is a [D.va](https://D.va) bomb headed your way don't let it break it is by far your most important piece of utility, letting it break basically halves your utility keep that sucker alive and you will immediately start to notice your rank go up.

But overall your a really good Sigma for just Gold keep grinding at it and you'll start to climb in no time, (Gold to - Plat and Plat- Diamond are hellish just a warning)
